arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind,service AS id,value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',booking_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference) FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'created_step',created_step) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',event_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',event_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status != 'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights

SELECT b.booking_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) AS matching_holds,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured') AS captures,(SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured') AS captured_cents,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.flight_id=b.flight_id AND c.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) AS matching_checkins,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered') AS delivered_events,(SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id) AS refunded_cents,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id AND e.kind='cancel') AS customer_cancellations FROM bookings b ORDER BY b.status,b.booking_id
